name: malleable-workspace
description: A radically malleable personal workspace with durable, bidirectional connections.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run bundle && node scripts/build-tests.mjs && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts examples tests vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json wrangler.jsonc

OWNER_KEY.description: Required: generate a unique 32-byte random base64url owner key. Never use the example placeholder. Used to sign in to your workspace.

WORKSPACE.description: Private SQLite-backed workspace and durable webhook schedule.
